name: Wolf + Bear Indoor Pickleball
note: Indoor courts in converted film sound stages on Calvert St: a black-box main hall (quilted acoustic blankets, a black truss ceiling with round LED high-bays, warm-grey courts on steel blue, low black mesh dividers), the cinder-block second hall, the streamed championship court with its flagstone spectator walk, and a private court. Court numbers follow the cards on the walls (12 and 14 are on the main hall's east wall); room positions are a reconstruction (docs/pickleball-venues.md).
